text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian and Biwa Hayahide are
staring out
across the track, having
finished preparations for
their special
race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The track's set, and we have a rough
estimate of
the turnout. All that's left
is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Figuring out who's gonna race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As it's the Fan Fest, this can't be
any
ordinary race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
So we gotta give the fans the matchup
they want
most.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...What about a one-on-one between
Teio and
McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A showdown between a
once-in-a-generation
genius and a
prodigy of distinguished lineage is

bound to draw a crowd. Another
possible
matchup would be...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A fight to reign supreme between the
Emperor
Symboli Rudolf and another
individual.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I think Maruzensky could take her on. Or
we
could have a Triple Crown event. A
dream race
with Mr. C.B....

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, the list goes on. Do you have
any ideas as
to who the most
crowd-pleasing racers might be?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Only one combo comes to mind. They're
the best
of the best.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Who in the world could you be
referring to?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That fancy brain of yours on sleep mode
or
something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Who do you think's standing right here?
Just a
couple of regular old runners?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Do you mean to say...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The theory wiz awakens. That's right, a
clash
between the world's mightiest
sisters!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But! You wish to have our showdown
here?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I know it's a little sooner than we
thought, but it'd
be pretty cool to see
who's strongest right now,
right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now that you mention it, people have been asking about it. This should have been my first thought.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps... I may have been
deliberately
putting it out of mind.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So how 'bout it, Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Do you even need to ask? I've been
waiting for
this a long time.

The day of the long-awaited race finally
arrives...
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There are more people here than I
expected... It
seems I miscalculated.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Goes to show how many people were
waiting to
see this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You good?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've not a flicker of doubt standing
beside you. I
feel absolutely amazing.
What about you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I'd be lying if I said I felt the same as
always.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
But it's a change for the better. I've
ripped down
countless barriers... I've
suffered through a lot...
but I'm standing
here now. That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm glad you're feeling well. It'd be
a pity if
you weren't.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Meaning?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's simple. I formulated my winning
equation
under the assumption that
you'd be in top running
condition!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, did you now? Well I'm gonna tear
that
equation to shreds!
Ka-chak!
Wooooo!

The race proves to be a truly spectacular
contest
that remains a vivid memory for
all who witness it.
